identitySignals: Agenda names 'Edgenuity, Inc.' in Scottsdale, AZ; Edgenuity (online courseware for grades 6-12) was based in Scottsdale, AZ (Wikipedia; Imagine Learning press release)

Imagine Learning's press release and product page show Edgenuity is now the 'Imagine Edgenuity' online courseware product of Imagine Learning, matching OUSD's classroom and academic program contract with the High School Linked Learning Office

Search results citing a school district filing say Edgenuity Inc. merged into Imagine Learning LLC effective January 1, 2022 (not directly verified; the filing blocked fetching), so Edgenuity, Inc. as named in the 2020-2023 agreement is likely no longer a separate legal entity
research.notes: Edgenuity, Inc. appears to have merged into Imagine Learning LLC effective 2022-01-01 (per search summary of a Florida school board document that could not be fetched). No registry confirmation (CA SOS, SAM.gov) was obtained, and Imagine Learning's contact page lists Tempe, AZ while the agenda and older sources say Scottsdale, AZ, so phone, email, address and registry IDs were left null. Reviewer should not publish without confirming the successor relationship and legal entity.

profile.summary: Edgenuity is an online learning company that provides digital courses for students in grades 6 to 12, including core subjects, electives, world languages, and career and technical education. Since 2021 its products have been sold under the Imagine Learning brand as 'Imagine Edgenuity'. Imagine Learning provides digital curriculum for K-12 schools.

sources.title: Imagine Learning Becomes New Brand for K-12 Digital Education Leader Weld North Education
